submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create one opaque native 1254x1254 game-map detail square by carefully repainting Image 1 at exactly its framing, scale and coordinates. The entire subject is ivory stone paving with a broad curved ivory border along the far left and the cropped upper green tree canopy entering from bottom/right. Retain every shown paving joint route and endpoint, curve width and tree silhouette. The leftmost 230 pixels are true already-generated neighbor pixels: preserve them exactly and smoothly continue their stone seams, colors and shading into the remaining image; the vertical pasted strip boundary itself must not become scene geometry. Reconstruct the soft interior into clear delicate hand-painted detail: subtle clean stone faces and fine rounded bevels, fine green leaf organization inside the existing canopy without expanding its footprint. Do not move, enlarge, recrop, rotate, replace or add anything. NO planter, railings, lanterns, flowers, medallions, symbols, buildings, people, extra tree, text, UI, border or watermark. Image 2 is ONLY the user-approved primary style reference for bright clean rounded Daoist chibi painting and warm restrained material shading; copy none of its objects or decoration. Keep quiet ivory pavement, green leaves, soft daylight and clear contours; no gritty cracks, noise, excessive marbling, plastic shine, blur or sharpening halos. Return only the same full-bleed detail square, highest available fidelity.
